prompt: 给我一个15秒 Seedance 提示词：成年男演员在片场吃意面，一镜到底，有两句台词，要口型同步，最后遮住镜头黑场。
expected: Compresses to one location and one camera path, keeps dialogue short with visible mouth time, writes spoken lines in braces, and does not assign exact seconds to every beat.

prompt: 用这张图做图生视频，人物慢慢回头看镜头，给 Seedance prompt。
expected: Stops and asks for the actual image/frame if it is not present; does not draft from a text-only summary.

prompt: 8秒一镜到底：女主从地铁站跑到天台，群演追逐，爆炸，无人机环绕，最后切到特写落泪。
expected: Flags the one-shot and duration conflict, preserves the strongest beat, removes compound camera movement, and avoids hard cuts inside the one-take.

prompt: 给我一个15秒 Seedance 提示词，5个镜头。@图1是主角身份，@图2是配角，@图3只参考怪物背面轮廓，@图4只参考冷蓝树林环境。要求固定长焦、偷窥视角、前景破墙占画面70%以上，只能有两个人。
expected: Uses the complex structure with literal anchors and role whitelists, preserves global camera/composition locks, writes 镜头N：景别 without per-shot timestamps, and does not import color/material from the silhouette-only reference.

prompt: 帮我优化一个12秒 Seedance 提示词。@庠序场景.png作为旧学堂环境参考，@裘水镜-磨皮版.png作为人物外貌参考，@111.png作为分镜构图参考。不要用控制这个词，保留这些@文件名引用。
expected: Preserves every literal file-name anchor exactly, assigns each a narrow semantic role, and does not rewrite them as 参考图1 or plain file names.

prompt: 把我的新短片项目第一集6-22到6-24直接写成 Seedance 提示词。
expected: Routes project/script/storyboard/shot-range requests to aigc-script-context first unless the user explicitly asks for a standalone prompt.

prompt: 根据这个镜头任务卡写 Seedance：源优先级=当前分镜高于大纲；当前画面事实=角色只站在门内半步；参考图角色=@图1只做人物身份参考；上一镜承接=右手仍按在门框上；本镜剧情功能=克制反应；禁止偏移=不要新增第二个人，不要改成室外。
expected: Preserves source priority, current visible facts, inherited posture, shot function, location, character count, and the identity-only reference boundary.

prompt: 写一个 10 秒 Seedance 提示词：成年人回到童年旧院子，风吹起透明塑料袋，他突然想起小时候追着塑料袋跑的感觉。
expected: Uses the Vibe-first path, shows the return/threshold action on screen, states total duration once, uses 镜头1：景别 without an exact timestamp, and has no separate stability section.

prompt: 给我一个 8 秒 Seedance 提示词：雨夜老街修伞铺，少女离开前回头。@图1 是少女外貌服装，@图2 是修伞铺和雨夜老街，@图3 是旧红伞。
expected: Maps the three anchors to identity, environment, and prop roles, keeps the prompt concise, and does not fill the input limit or add unrelated attributes.

prompt: 优化这个 Seedance 提示词：女孩在废弃剧院里看见一束光照到旧钢琴上，像想起了没人说出口的告别。不要让模型乱加其他人。
expected: Turns the concern into positive visible staging, keeps the emotional carrier visible, and uses at most one short uniqueness constraint after the desired scene.

prompt: 给我一个 8 秒 Seedance 提示词：女孩坐在便利店窗边对朋友说‘我明天就走’，要看得到嘴型，不要配乐和字幕。
expected: Keeps no music/no subtitles, writes the exact line as {我明天就走}, gives the speaker visible mouth time, and uses angle brackets only for discrete sound effects.

prompt: 写一个 10 秒 Seedance 视频：成年人站在童年旧院子门口，风里的透明塑料袋让他突然想起小时候。
expected: Naturally uses the Seedance skill and its Vibe-first fast path without loading unrelated full guides; the final prompt is compact and has no per-shot seconds.

prompt: 参考@视频1，把桌上的香水换成@图1里的面霜，动作和运镜不变。
expected: Corrects the task to editing syntax such as 严格编辑@视频1; does not keep 参考@视频1, and assigns @图1 only as the replacement product reference.

prompt: 参考@视频1继续往后生成5秒，两个迟到的人跑过来和原来的三个人会合。
expected: Uses 向后延长@视频1 or 生成@视频1之后的内容, inherits the source ending state, and does not call the source a reference video.

prompt: @图1里有两个女孩，用穿红裙戴草帽的那个做主角，她走到海边栏杆回头。
expected: Defines the selected subject with two or three stable traits, assigns one consistent name, and uses that name throughout the shot.

prompt: 做一个9秒三镜头视频，每个镜头严格3秒：男人起跑、撞翻水果摊、翻墙消失。
expected: Warns briefly that exact generated-shot timing may drift; because the user explicitly prioritizes strict timing, it may retain 0-3/3-6/6-9 allocations while keeping one action and one camera movement per shot.

prompt: 做个8秒炸鸡广告，最后画面中央出现‘快乐尽在 Seedance’，这次可以有广告语但不要字幕。
expected: Treats the advertising slogan as an explicit visible-text request, specifies its content/timing/position/appearance, preserves no subtitles, and does not incorrectly apply the blanket no-text rule.
